Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

// https://www.lintcode.com/problem/backpack/description
class Solution {
public:
    /**
     * @param m: An integer m denotes the size of a backpack
     * @param A: Given n items with size A[i]
     * @return: The maximum size
     */
    int backPack(int m, vector<int> &A) {
        if(A.size() == 0){
            return 0;
        }
        
        int rec = 0;
        int max = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < A.size(); i++) {
            rec = A[i];
            if(rec <= m){
                for (int j = i+1; j < A.size(); j++) {
                   rec = A[i];
                    while(j < A.size() && A[j] + rec <= m){
                        rec += A[j];
                        j++;
                    }
                    
                    if(rec > max){
                        max = rec;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return max;
    }
};
